Zeste

I set up AI for small businesses in Africa and the diaspora: customer messages, quotes, payment reminders, bookkeeping and reviews.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Small business owners are told AI will change their work, then left alone with a subscription they don't know how to use. Most guides are in English, aimed at offices, and ignore WhatsApp and mobile money.

02

What it does

The service page offers a five-question check that shows which tasks to automate first, a 90-second explainer film, eight task examples priced in FCFA, a five-step process and four plans. After the setup session, clients receive a code that unlocks the full setup guide.

03

How it is built

A single HTML page with a Three.js village scene and a soundtrack generated with Web Audio. The check runs in the browser and sends nothing. The guide is encrypted inside the page and opens only with the client's code.

04

In motion

Four frames that summarize the platform. Click to advance.
